name: @pipeworx/mcp-random-tables

tools.name: roll_table
tools.description: Pipeworx original random tables: roll one or more entries from a built-in table — encounters_fantasy, encounters_scifi, encounters_modern, loot, weather, complication, npc_personality, npc_secret, npc_occupation, plot_hook, tavern, rumour, settlement_quirk, npc_full. Entries may contain {{table:<id>}} references to OTHER built-in tables, resolved recursively (up to 6 levels deep) — the response gives both the raw entry text and the fully resolved text. Optional seed makes the roll reproducible (same seed + arguments = same result; the seed used is always returned). Optional session_id draws without replacement across repeated calls (hosted only, via the gateway's shared KV) — pass none to get an ordinary independent weighted roll every time, or pass any string to start tracking a no-repeat session (the response returns the real session_id to reuse). No text from any commercial RPG product — every table and entry is written for Pipeworx.

table.description: Built-in table id, e.g. "loot", "npc_full", "encounters_fantasy". Call list_random_tables to see every id.

seed.description: Optional seed for a reproducible roll. Omit for fresh randomness; the seed actually used is always returned.

session_id.description: Optional. Omit for an ordinary independent weighted roll. Pass a session_id (your own first time, or one returned by a previous call) to draw without replacement across calls — hosted only.

tools.name: roll_custom_table
tools.description: Pipeworx original random tables: roll one or more entries from a table YOU supply — bring your own weighted list of { text, weight? } and get back a reproducible weighted draw. Entries may contain {{table:<id>}} references to Pipeworx's BUILT-IN random tables (e.g. "{{table:npc_personality}}"), resolved recursively (up to 6 levels deep). Optional seed makes the roll reproducible; the seed used is always returned. No session support for custom tables — use roll_table for session-tracked built-in tables.

entries.description: Your table: a non-empty array of { text: string, weight?: number > 0 (default 1) }. Up to 500 entries.

text.description: The entry text; may embed {{table:<built-in id>}} references.

seed.description: Optional seed for a reproducible roll. Omit for fresh randomness; the seed actually used is always returned.

tools.name: list_random_tables
tools.description: Pipeworx original random tables: list every built-in table id, title, genre and entry count, optionally filtered to one genre ("fantasy", "scifi" or "modern"). Genre-agnostic tables (loot, weather, npc_*, complication, plot_hook, rumour, settlement_quirk, npc_full) are included under every genre filter, since they apply regardless of setting.

genre.description: Optional genre filter. Omit to list every table.

tools.name: get_random_table
tools.description: Pipeworx original random tables: fetch one built-in table in full — its title, genre, description, and every raw entry (text + weight) — without rolling. Entry text may contain unresolved {{table:<id>}} references; roll_table resolves those at roll time.

table.description: Built-in table id, e.g. "loot", "npc_full", "encounters_fantasy". Call list_random_tables to see every id.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-random-tables forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the random-tables pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
